Package com.csse3200.game.components.loot

Class BuffEffect

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.loot.BuffEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConsumableEffect
public class BuffEffect extends Object implements ConsumableEffect
Applies a temporary stat modifier that reverts automatically after a fixed duration.

The timing and reverting are owned by PlayerBuffComponent; this effect only describes what to apply.
